patch.search:
"export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive",
        "apt-get update -qq",
        "apt-get install -y -qq --no-install-recommends openssh-server ca-certificates python3 python3-venv python3-pip git curl ffmpeg",
patch.replace:
...(runtimeProbeAuthorized ? [
            "RUNTIME_ROOT=/workspace/jarvis-v142/runtime/humo17",
            "SYSTEM_ROOT=$RUNTIME_ROOT/system",
            "test -x /usr/sbin/sshd",
            "test -x $SYSTEM_ROOT/bin/ffmpeg && test -x $SYSTEM_ROOT/bin/ffprobe && test -x $SYSTEM_ROOT/bin/git",

            "export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive",
            "apt-get update -qq",
            "apt-get install -y -qq --no-install-recommends openssh-server ca-certificates python3 python3-venv python3-pip git curl ffmpeg"
        ]),
